
```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="hi">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>CDN से Library Load करना</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .container {
            background: white;
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 30px;
            max-width: 700px;
            width: 100%;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
        }

        h1 {
            color: #333;
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 25px;
            font-size: 24px;
        }

        .status-box {
            background: #f8f9fa;
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            border-left: 4px solid #667eea;
        }

        .status-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #555;
        }

        .status-item:last-child {
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }

        .status-icon {
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            margin-right: 10px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 12px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .loading {
            background: #ffc107;
            animation: pulse 1s infinite;
        }

        .success {
            background: #28a745;
            color: white;
        }

        .error {
            background: #dc3545;
            color: white;
        }

        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
            50% { opacity: 0.5; }
        }

        .btn {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea, #764ba2);
            color: white;
            border: none;
            padding: 12px 25px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 14px;
            margin: 5px;
            transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
        }

        .btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.4);
        }

        .btn:disabled {
            opacity: 0.6;
            cursor: not-allowed;
            transform: none;
        }

        .demo-section {
            background: #f0f4ff;
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 20px;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .demo-section h3 {
            color: #333;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            font-size: 16px;
        }

        #demo-box {
            background: white;
            border: 2px solid #ddd;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 15px;
            min-height: 60px;
            text-align: center;
            color: #666;
            font-size: 14px;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .log-section {
            background: #1a1a2e;
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 15px;
            margin-top: 20px;
            max-height: 200px;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }

        .log-section h3 {
            color: #a0a0ff;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .log-entry {
            color: #00ff88;
            font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            padding: 3px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #333;
        }

        .log-entry.error-log {
            color: #ff6b6b;
        }

        .log-entry.info-log {
            color: #74b9ff;
        }

        .library-cards {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .library-card {
            background: #f8f9fa;
            border: 2px solid #ddd;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 12px;
            text-align: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            font-size: 13px;
        }

        .library-card:hover {
            border-color: #667eea;
            background: #f0f4ff;
        }

        .library-card.selected {
            border-color: #667eea;
            background: #667eea;
            color: white;
        }

        .library-card .lib-name {
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .library-card .lib-version {
            font-size: 11px;
            opacity: 0.7;
        }

        .progress-bar {
            width: 100%;
            height: 6px;
            background: #eee;
            border-radius: 3px;
            margin-top: 10px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .progress-fill {
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #667eea, #764ba2);
            border-radius: 3px;
            width: 0%;
            transition: width 0.3s;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="container">
        <h1>🚀 CDN Library Loader</h1>
        
        <div class="library-cards">
            <div class="library-card selected" onclick="selectLibrary('jquery')" id="card-jquery">
                <div class="lib-name">jQuery</div>
                <div class="lib-version">v3.7.1</div>
            </div>
            <div class="library-card" onclick="selectLibrary('lodash')" id="card-lodash">
                <div class="lib-name">Lodash</div>
                <div class="lib-version">v4.17.21</div>
            </div>
            <div class="library-card" onclick="selectLibrary('moment')" id="card-moment">
                <div class="lib-name">Moment.js</div>
                <div class="lib-version">v2.29.4</div>
            </div>
            <div class="library-card" onclick="selectLibrary('axios')" id="card-axios">
                <div class="lib-name">Axios</div>
                <div class="lib-version">v1.6.2</div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="status-box">
            <div class="status-item">
                <div class="status-icon loading" id="status-icon">⏳</div>
                <span id="status-text">Library लोड होने की प्रतीक्षा में...</span>
            </div>
            <div class="progress-bar">
                <div class="progress-fill" id="progress-fill"></div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div style="text-align: center;">
            <button class="btn" onclick="loadSelectedLibrary()" id="load-btn">
                📥 Library Load करें
            </button>
            <button class="btn" onclick="runDemo()" id="demo-btn" disabled>
                ▶️ Demo चलाएं
            </button>
            <button class="btn" onclick="clearAll()">
                🗑️ Clear करें
            </button>
        </div>

        <div class="demo-section">
            <h3>📋 Demo Output:</h3>
            <div id="demo-box">Library लोड करने के बाद Demo चलाएं...</div>
        </div>

        <div class="log-section">
            <h3>📝 Console Log:</h3>
            <div id="log-container"></div>
        </div>
    </div>
